description: Geological Survey and Mines Bureau - Amendment to the Mining (Licensing) Regulations, No. 1 of 1993 Published in Gaz. Ex. No. 794/23 of 26.11.1993
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the President under the Mines and Minerals Act, No. 33 of 1992, which constitutes legal/regulatory content. It amends existing mining licensing regulations, specifies application procedures, license categories, validity periods, and operational requirements - all characteristic of statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
